mapper.select: select distinct p.id, p.code, p.name, p.url, p.parent_id, p.perm_type, p.icon, p.sort, p.status, p.create_time from t_permission p left join t_role_permission rp on p.id = rp.permission_id left join t_role r on r.id = rp.role_id left join t_user_role ur on r.id = ur.role_id left join t_user u on u.id = ur.user_id where u.username = #{username} and p.status = 1 order by p.sort
select * from t_permission order by sort

select * from t_permission
and code like concat('%', #{code}, '%')
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
order by sort limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select count(*) from t_permission
and code like concat('%', #{code}, '%')
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')

select p.id, p.code, p.name, p.url, p.parent_id, p.perm_type, p.icon, p.sort, p.status, p.create_time from t_permission p left join t_role_permission rp on p.id = rp.permission_id where rp.role_id = #{roleId} order by p.sort
mapper.insert: insert into t_permission(code, name, url, parent_id, perm_type, icon, sort, status) values(#{code}, #{name}, #{url}, #{parentId}, #{permType}, #{icon}, #{sort}, #{status})
